items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
LEARNED LESSONS (observed unless marked guess/uncertain)

CONTROLS: WASD moves; arrow keys fire. E drops a bomb at feet (~1s fuse, ~2-tile radius); bomb count decrements on placement. Bombs damage self. Q and Space do nothing. Diagonal/single-axis moves stall against rocks whose hitboxes exceed their sprites; reposition lanes rather than pushing.

TECH X: pill pedestal in the two-poop room re-grants Tech X on entry. Firing produces a ~1s lingering laser ring at a fixed offset (~0.15–0.2 room-units) along the firing direction on the player's row/column; rocks block it; alignment matters. The red squiggly ring is my own laser effect, NOT a lock marker or enemy telegraph (corrects an earlier belief; uncertain). Lasers kill white-faced chasers safely at range.

CHESTS/CONTAINERS: gray chests open by contact (TNT room lore); the left-wall gray plates in the TNT room are inert decorations (confirmed no reaction). Coin pot in the two-poop room breaks on contact, yields a coin (coins 00→01) — do not waste lasers on it. Red-lidded brown barrels/containers suspected KEY-LOCKED (keys counter never rose above 00; a key-shaped pickup earlier did not raise it). Torch-room center gray chest fully sealed by indestructible rocks — tested left, top, right; ABANDON. Chest in the dark chest room ringed with white spikes is untouchable.

BOMBS — FAILED STRATEGY: bombing the two-poop room center rock cost a heart and broke nothing; warping away does NOT outrun the fuse. Never bomb at low hearts or adjacent to self; retreat to a far corner if bombing at all. Rocks judged indestructible.

HAZARDS: GREEN GLOWING BLOBS damage on contact (multiple confirmed heart losses) — keep away. Rock field is a severe heart-drainer; enemies cluster near its hatches. Observed there: small spiky pellet projectiles (guess: fired by a spawner/turret near bottom-right), spiked-wheel decorations on the right wall, white-faced chasers, blue-tear shooters, a spiked-ring enemy, and a gray round enemy sitting on/near the top hatch. Blobs transform (winged/spread/large fast green forms). Corner torches damage on touch.

NEW LESSON (this run): entering the rock field straight from the tutorial without Tech X drained 3 hearts to zero in roughly a minute; enemies near the hatch make warp attempts lethal. Preferred route: obtain Tech X first (torch room → two-poop room) before any rock-field trip, and never linger on hatch frames there.

PICKUPS: hearts need overlap (+1). Bomb-fuse sprite in TNT room is a BOMB PICKUP (auto-collects on overlap, harmless). Coin pickup tolerance otherwise unresolved (some gold specks never register).

HATCH/WARP MECHANICS: requires near-exact x-centering plus a sustained walk started ~0.1–0.2 units from the frame; standing on the frame blocks the warp — step back ~0.2, re-center, then hold the direction. Sometimes multiple attempts; if it fails, back off and re-center rather than pressing harder.

MAP / ROUTES:
- Tutorial: top hatch x~0.50 ↔ rock field; bottom hatch x~0.49–0.50 ↔ torch room; right doorway y~0.47 ↔ dark chest room.
- Rock field: bottom hatch ↔ tutorial; top hatch x~0.50 ↔ TNT room; keyhole door on left wall ~x0.19–0.20, y~0.44–0.48 (no key yet).
- Torch room: top hatch x~0.50 ↔ tutorial; gold bottom-center hatch x~0.50, y~0.76–0.79 ↔ two-poop room (approach ~0.1 above, centered); safe left lane x~0.31–0.42 full height; right lane x~0.63 traversable down.
- Two-poop room: only exit is the top crown hatch x~0.50 (approach from ~0.1 below); poop piles regenerate on re-entry and drop nothing; center rock indestructible.
- TNT room (rock-field top exit): TNT barrels line left wall and mid-room, block movement, inert (don't shoot at close range); red-lidded brown barrels near left wall; top dark hatch x~0.50, y~0.15 ↔ pink-enemy room; bottom hatch ↔ rock field.
- Pink-enemy rock room (TNT top hatch): two pink fat enemies, rock wall right with a poop pile containing gold/blue flies, three dark teardrop pickups, gray chest with spiky black edges at left. Pink enemy behavior UNTESTED.
- Dark chest room (right of tutorial): chaser den; two red-lidded brown containers; central red-lidded chest in white spikes; black blob/pit shapes; gold/olive specks.

GOALS: hearts are the priority resource; keys never obtained (counter stays 00). Open red-lidded/ringed containers, presumed key-locked. Probe the rock-field keyhole door only with a confirmed key.

UNRESOLVED: where/whether keys exist; what opens the keyhole door; contents of the torch-room enclosed chest; nature of the dark teardrop pickups in the pink room; green blob effect beyond heart loss; exact coin pickup tolerance; whether lasers can open any chest through a rock ring (evidence: no).
